facts.text: The resort's private villas edge porcelain sands and are framed by thirty acres of forest.
facts.excerpt: Embrace restorative luxury in private villas edging porcelain sands framed by thirty acres of forest.

facts.text: The resort is on the West Coast Road at Anse Louis on Mahe Island, Seychelles.
facts.excerpt: Anantara Maia Seychelles Villas is located on the West Coast Road, Anse Louis, Mahe Island, Seychelles.

facts.text: The resort sits on a petite peninsula on Mahe's southwest coast, separating Anse Louis and Anse Boileau.
facts.excerpt: situated on a dreamy, petite peninsula separating Anse Louis and Anse Boileau

facts.text: The villas were designed by Bill Bensley and combine rustic hammered copper with elegant soft furnishings.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in Bill Bensley-designed villas that combine rustic elements of hammered copper with elegant soft furnishings.

facts.text: Villas are located either on the beach or on the hilltop, overlooking the secluded coastline and the Indian Ocean.
facts.excerpt: located either on the beach or the hilltop, with a unique perspective of the secluded coastline and sparkling Indian Ocean.

facts.text: Each villa has a private infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Have a relaxing swim in your infinity pool while admiring the abundance of this natural paradise.

facts.text: Each villa has a sun deck and an outdoor sunken bathtub.
facts.excerpt:
- Sun deck in each room
- Outdoor sunken bath tub in each villa

facts.text: The villas have thatched roofs and are all identical in size and layout; they differ in their views.
facts.excerpt: All 30 thatched-roof villas are identical in terms of size and layout

facts.text: The Premier Beach Pool Villas are linked by garden walkways, suit families and have direct access to Anse Louis Beach.
facts.excerpt: Linked easily through garden walkways, the nine Premier Beach Pool Villas are ideal for families and enjoy direct access to the soft white sands of Anse Louis Beach.

facts.text: Peninsula Ocean View Pool Villas sit on the edge of the peninsula with open views of the Indian Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Peninsula Ocean View Pool Villas are perfectly located on the edge of the peninsula, offering the experience of ultimate privacy and open views of the Indian Ocean.

facts.text: Each villa has a dedicated Villa Host.
facts.excerpt: Dedicated Villa Host

facts.text: The Villa Host is assigned to one villa only and is reachable 24/7 by WhatsApp.
facts.excerpt: this host is your first point of contact, available 24/7 by What’s App

facts.text: The Anantara Spa has open-air treatment pavilions.
facts.excerpt: Anantara Spa with open air pavilions

facts.text: The spa offers The Maia Signature Massage, a long-stroke, stretch-heavy treatment developed for the resort.
facts.excerpt: One treatment to try is The Maia Signature Massage, which is a long-stroke and stretch-heavy treatment developed specifically for the resort.

facts.text: Spa therapists come from Thailand and Bali.
facts.excerpt: Therapists hail from Thailand and Bali

facts.text: The resort offers yoga and wellness sessions and Technogym workouts.
facts.excerpt:
- Yoga and wellness sessions
- Island excursions
- Bill Bensley-designed accommodation
- Technogym workouts

facts.text: The resort has a padel court.
facts.excerpt: Wine cellarPadel court

facts.text: The resort has a beachside sunset bar and an award-winning wine list.
facts.excerpt:
- Beachside sunset bar
- Award-winning wine list

facts.text: With the Dining by Design concept, guests can choose from a range of gourmet cuisines with a choice of backdrops.
facts.excerpt: Explore a range of gourmet cuisines with a choice of exquisite backdrops with our exclusive Dining by Design concept.

facts.text: The resort has a single open-air restaurant, Tec Tec, with menus spanning cuisines from Creole to Mediterranean to Indian.
facts.excerpt: The resort has a single open-air restaurant, Tec Tec, but its menus are many.

facts.text: The spa has a kids' wellness menu, including the Happy Feet foot scrub and massage.
facts.excerpt: Another standout of this spa is a kids’ wellness menu, which includes treatments like the Happy Feet foot scrub and massage

facts.text: There is no kids' club, but the Very Important Kids Program includes supervised water sports, cooking and painting.
facts.excerpt: While there’s no Kid’s Club per se, the resort offers a Very Important Kids Program, tailor made to include water sports, cooking, painting and more, all supervised by the recreation team.

facts.text: With the Marine Conservation Society Seychelles, the resort runs a long-term sea turtle monitoring program on Anse Louis beach, a nesting beach for Hawksbill and Green turtles.
facts.excerpt: has developed a long-term sea turtle monitoring program on Anse Louis beach, a nesting beach for Hawksbill and Green turtles

facts.text: Scuba diving can be organised with a nearby preferred dive centre.
facts.excerpt: Scuba diving can be organised with our nearby preferred dive centre.

facts.text: The resort can arrange day trips to neighbouring islands.
facts.excerpt: The resort can also arrange day trips to neighboring islands.

facts.text: Guests can walk to Anse Boileau, a small fishing village a few minutes away with a local market and a Catholic church.
facts.excerpt: can walk to Anse Boileau, a small fishing village a few minutes away, with a local market and a Catholic church

facts.text: The resort is approximately 35 minutes from the international airport by car, depending on traffic.
facts.excerpt: Our resort is approximately 35 minutes from the international airport by car, depending on traffic.

facts.text: Room rates are subject to a sustainable environmental fee per villa per night, invoiced separately.
facts.excerpt: All room rates are subject to a sustainable environmental fee of EUR 10 per villa per night, which will be invoiced separately

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the resort.
facts.excerpt: we are not equipped to deal with pets at our luxury resort

facts.text: Hilltop villas have more sweeping ocean views, while those nearer sea level see more foliage and less water but have direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: some are situated hilltop, lending to more sweeping ocean vistas, while those closer to sea level peninsula see a bit less water and more foliage but offer a comparative advantage of direct beach access

facts.text: Anantara acquired the resort in late 2020, added the Anantara Spa and introduced a Beyond All Inclusive policy.
facts.excerpt: In late 2020, Anantara acquired the resort, added an Anantara Spa, did a soft refresh of the property, and introduced the much-loved “Beyond All Inclusive” policy.
